PART III - LANDS NOTICE CALLING FOR CLAIMS TO PROPERTY OF INTESTATE REGISTRATION OF TITLE ACT NO. 21 OF 1998 (SECTION 55) Reference the intestate property of late Mr. Wannakuwatta Waduge Bonifas Fernando who resides in the village of Laxapathiya, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Moratuwa, in the District of Colombo. It is hereby notified that any person/s who have a claim to or interest in the intestate property of the late Mr. Wannakuwatta Waduge Bonifas Fernando described in the Schedule hereto should submit his/their claim to the undersigned in writing before 26th January 2015 stating his/their right or interest to such intestate property. In case of failure to do so, exparte action will be taken to register title under Section 55 (2) and (3) of the Registration of Title Act. No. 21 of 1998. GAMINI ILANGARATHNA, Commissioner of Title Settlement. Land Title Settlement Department, No. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Madura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla. 08th December, 2014. SCHEDULE Divisional Village Cadastral Parcel No. Extent of Land Certificate Office of Secretary’s Division Map No. of Title No. Registration

(Hectare) Moratuwa Laxapathiya 520210 Block 14 0.0193 2501810 Colombo Parcel No. 219 N.B.- Letters claiming a right to intestate property should mention the Cadastral Map number, parcel number and the entitlement of the claimant to claim such property. The top left-hand corner of the envelope should bear the phrase “Application for Intestate Property.” 02 - 47 / 1
